title: V11 Module Manifest
description: Self-describing manifest for a source code module. Addresses Dark Code Layer 2 (Structural Context): every module must declare its responsibility, dependencies, and consumers so that code is legible without re-reading it. Lives as sidecar MODULE.md or embedded JSON in module docstring.

name.description: Module name, typically matching the directory or file basename

path.description: Relative path from project root (e.g., src/api/auth/)

responsibility.description: One-paragraph statement of what this module owns. Should answer: 'What problem does this module solve that no other module solves?'

stability.description: Stability tier. experimental: expect changes. stable: public API locked. frozen: no changes without migration plan. deprecated: do not extend.

owner_agent.description: Agent ID or role responsible for this module (e.g., backend-architect, spec-implementer-v11)

public_interface.description: Publicly exported symbols that other modules may depend on. Internal symbols are NOT listed here.

upstream_dependencies.description: Modules and libraries THIS module depends on. Direct imports only, not transitive.

downstream_consumers.description: Modules/services that depend on this module. Maintained during refactoring. Glob patterns allowed (e.g., 'src/routes/**/').

invariants.description: Conditions this module GUARANTEES to its callers. Violating an invariant is a contract breach. Example: 'User IDs are never reused after account deletion.'

performance_envelope.description: Performance expectations. Absence means 'not performance-critical' — which is itself a statement.

failure_modes.description: Known failure modes and how this module handles them. Addresses Dark Code Layer 3 (Resilience Protocols).

related_spec.description: Relative path to spec.md section governing this module

last_reviewed.description: Last date a human or adversarial-reviewer validated this manifest against actual code

symbol.description: Function, class, type, or constant name

idempotent.description: Safe to call multiple times with same args?

side_effects.description: Observable effects beyond return value (DB writes, network calls, file I/O)

why.description: Why THIS dependency was chosen. Addresses Dark Code Layer 4 'architectural probing' at the module level.

substitutable.description: Can this dependency be swapped without changing the module's public interface?

user_visible.description: Does the user see this failure, or is it absorbed internally?
